about.title: The person behind the ideas.
bio: I'm Luana Costa, a qualified mediamatics professional from Switzerland. During my apprenticeship, I had the opportunity to explore different areas of media production and gain experience through a wide range of projects.
Here, I share a selection of my work and my personal perspective on design.

poster-series.title: Sound & Form
poster-series.summary: Demo content: a typographic poster series that translates rhythm and volume into form.
poster-series.brief: Example brief: three posters for a fictional concert series that work even from a distance.
poster-series.challenge: Using only type, shape and colour to build a series that belongs together while each poster stands on its own.
poster-series.role: Concept, typography and final artwork (example text).
process: Paper sketches to find rhythms and shapes.
A grid and colour palette that connect all posters.
Full-size test prints to check impact and legibility.
poster-series.outcome: A series of three posters. Real results will be described here later.

city-light.title: City Light
city-light.summary: Demo content: a photo series about light and shadow in the city at dusk.
city-light.brief: Example brief: a series with a consistent mood, shot in different locations.
city-light.challenge: Bringing changing light conditions together in one visual language.
process: Scouting locations at different times of day.
A shared colour grade for the whole series.
city-light.outcome: A series with a consistent colour mood. Real results will be described here later.

short-film.title: In Between
short-film.summary: Demo content: a short film about journeys, pauses and the moments in between.
short-film.brief: Example brief: a short film of about two minutes without dialogue.
short-film.challenge: Telling a story through images, editing and sound alone.
process: A storyboard with the key shots.
Two shooting days with natural light.
Editing, colour correction and sound mixing.
short-film.outcome: A short film in web quality. Real results will be described here later.

brand-identity.title: Brand Study
brand-identity.summary: Demo content: a visual identity for a fictional small brand, from logo to packaging.
brand-identity.brief: Example brief: a flexible identity that works on paper and on screen.
brand-identity.challenge: Finding a mark that is simple enough for small sizes and distinctive enough for large surfaces.
brand-identity.role: Concept, logo and brand guidelines (example text).
process: Applications such as business cards, packaging and social media templates.
brand-identity.outcome: A compact brand manual. Real results will be described here later.

web-concept.title: Culture Guide
web-concept.summary: Demo content: a web concept for a fictional events guide, designed for mobile and desktop.
web-concept.brief: Example brief: present events clearly and make them quick to find.
web-concept.challenge: Organising a lot of information so it stays clear and comfortable to read on small screens.
web-concept.role: Concept, interface design and prototype (example text).
process: Mapping user journeys and prioritising content.
A clickable prototype, tested with friends.
web-concept.outcome: A clickable prototype. Real results will be described here later.
